rationale: SHAZ has already gapped up 21.45% and is trading at 93% of today's range near the session high, with the last candle showing a surge in volume (50K vs prior 5-16K) pushing price toward the $21.87 high — this is a late-stage momentum move with unfavorable risk/reward for a long entry and insufficient evidence of distribution or reversal structure to justify a short. The broad market is strongly up (SPY +5.49%, VIXY -16%) which supports the gap but also means most of the move is already captured. With an existing working long order in FUTU consuming buying power and no clear mechanical edge in either direction at this extended level, skipping preserves capital.
